# Oveliqt — Software, AI & Digital Products

Oveliqt builds websites, custom platforms and applied AI.

Site: https://oveliqt.com · Contact: info@oveliqt.com

## Routes

- / — Six featured projects
- /work — All seven projects, filterable by Websites, Platforms and AI & Research
- /services — Overview of the six services
- /services/web-development, /services/software-development, /services/mobile-applications, /services/ai-machine-learning, /services/data-analytics, /services/automation-integrations — One page per service: capabilities, delivery approach, case studies and FAQs
- /pricing — Ways to work together: discovery sprint, fixed-scope projects and ongoing partnership; starting scopes, process and pricing FAQ
- /about — Studio and approach
- /contact — Guided enquiry; send the prepared message by WhatsApp or email (info@oveliqt.com)

## Projects

- /work/ecobe — ECOBE: Client website. From a printed catalogue to a browsable collection.
- /work/soliaris — Soliaris Africa: Client website. A regional energy story, brought online.
- /work/energex — Energex: Client website. A complex energy offer, made easier to explore.
- /work/crosswalk-intelligence — Crosswalk Intelligence: Independent prototype. From traffic footage to reviewable crossing events.
- /work/axeora — Axeora: Client website. A clear digital presence for a complex technology business.
- /work/education-operations — Education Operations Platform: Partner contribution. Register a learner. Record the day. See what needs attention.
- /work/cira — CIRA: Independent prototype. Citizens report it. Officers resolve it. Everyone sees the status.

Education and Crosswalk covers are conceptual product visualisations, not actual screenshots. Contribution and evaluation limits are stated in their case studies.
